boardRow.name: The Drill Yard
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Practice ground: no stakes, no claim. The county lends the gold; the straw men lend their patience.

goals: Practice on the straw men and rolling logs.
rules: Pull the assay-tent lever to top up practice gold.
Ring the Drill Bell for one small wave.
Nothing in the yard enters the county ledger.
briefing.geographyLine: A borrowed corner of the river claim at the edge of town.
